policy: Union these families with the original split groups. Preserve every exposed validation task. Quarantine every original heldout member of a component touching validation; never promote validation to heldout.

families.reason: Both metadata descriptions identify vehicle routing / operations research; category sublabels alone miss this relation.
Shared control, simulation and dynamics family; conservative grouping across vehicle, thermal and robot sublabels.
Both explicitly share excel-index-match and statistics tags. This is a conservative workflow family, not evidence of identical data.
PCAP/network intrusion tasks have different subcategory spellings; avoid counting them as independent families.
Shared React/Next.js performance family, already kept together by the original grouping.
Identical seismology/ai4science metadata tags; both remain heldout and group together.
Group grid dispatch with the energy family; all remain heldout.
Both explicitly expose PDF form filling; all remain heldout.

reviewed_generic_matches.decision: Do not merge solely on generic python/data-analysis/timeseries tags; different stated task families.
Same author and PDF tool type do not establish a shared task family or common source data.
Same author and generic security tag do not join network intrusion and kernel fuzzing families.

limits: No heldout instructions, verifier bodies, solutions or outcomes were inspected.
Metadata and whole-task digests cannot certify absence of semantic or partial data duplicates.
This review creates a versioned proposal; it does not silently replace the frozen runner rosters.
